meaning: mild synthetic relief: silkscreen proud (+1), tin pads below the mask (-1), gold below (-0.6 / -0.3); markings and IC bodies flat

method.segmentation: PIL HSV (0..255) soft classes with smoothstep edges; weights normalised per pixel
method.pad_highlight_rule: silk weight inside holes of the tin mask after a 1 px closing -> tin
method.silk_halo_excludes: tin within 1 px of the tin mask eroded by 2 px
method.marking_rule: tin/silk weight inside holes of the dark mask after a 2 px closing -> marking

disclosure: Photo-derived, not measured: this map re-weights the pixels of the photo texture it was segmented from by their colour (teal = solder mask, white = silkscreen, grey = tin, black = IC body, tan = gold, pale pixels enclosed by a black body = matte marking). A white pixel is treated as silkscreen whether it is silkscreen or white plastic, a grey pixel as metal whether it is a pad or a grey part. Nothing is added that the photograph does not show.
